text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/merge_duplicates.py (P1): a one-time script that loads data/registry.json, groups household records that are the same family under slightly different name spellings (reusing registry/dedup.py's find_duplicate_groups when available, with a normalized-name fallback), validates household IDs via core/ids.py, keeps the record with the valid household ID, and marks the other record(s) in each group as merged (status='merged' plus a merged_into reference) without deleting anything. It writes the updated registry back and appends merge_duplicate entries to data/audit.jsonl. Ran it once (P2) and verified with a check script that each real family now has exactly one active record, kept records have valid household IDs, no records were deleted, and only the duplicate records were changed, with audit entries appended.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
